name: Hospitalfield
funding: £839k income (FY2025); Creative Scotland, Historic Environment Scotland, National Lottery Heritage Fund, Foyle Foundation, Robertson Trust, Garfield Weston Foundation, William Grant Foundation.
records_note: No annual reports; OSCR holds accounts for 2020 to 2025, the Future Plan page names funders without a date, and the board is listed.

name: Hubei Museum of Art
funding: Provincial public museum under the Hubei Dept of Culture and Tourism, funded through the provincial budget (2026 unit budget filed).
records_note: Publishes no reports, funders or board; its parent department lists its 2026 unit budget on the provincial budget portal, with no final accounts.

name: Hugh Lane Gallery
records_note: hughlane.ie blocked the check; parent Dublin City Council posts annual reports 2016 to 2025 and audited accounts 2015 to 2025.

name: Human Resources LA (HRLA)
funding: Andy Warhol Foundation, Mike Kelley Foundation for the Arts, California Arts Council, community donations; 501(c)(3) non-profit.
watch: Artist-run non-profit in Chinatown; dedicated to performance, conceptual actions, and queer community programming.

name: Humboldt Forum
funding: Federal Government Commissioner for Culture and the Media (BKM).
watch: Restitution debates (Benin bronzes) and freelance contractor payment processing reviews at the reconstructed Schloss.

name: IAIA Museum of Contemporary Native Arts
funding: Part of IAIA (2023 revenue $30.1M); Congress appropriated $13.48M for Jul 2026-Sep 2027; Art Bridges and Ford Foundation grants to the museum.
watch: Tribal-college museum run by IAIA. The Trump FY2026 budget proposed closing IAIA, but the Senate funded it anyway.
records_note: Parent IAIA posts financial statements and a trustee list; ProPublica carries its Form 990s for 2012 to 2024; no annual report or donor list found.

name: Institute of Contemporary Arts (ICA)
funding: Arts Council England National Portfolio funding, membership, cinema tickets, foundation grants.
watch: Historic contemporary arts institute; employee reports regarding building infrastructure and compensation.

name: Ikon Gallery
funding: Arts Council England supports it with National Lottery funding. Current corporate patrons: Deutsche Bank, Elonex, Howells, Kier and Transport for West Midlands.
watch: New York regulators fined Deutsche Bank $150M in July 2020 for ignoring red flags on Jeffrey Epstein's accounts. No protest at Ikon turned up.
records_note: Annual reviews 2023 and 2024 are online; accounts are on the Charity Commission register; corporate patrons are named, undated; trustees are listed.

name: ILHAM Gallery
funding: No funder list is published. Yayasan ILHAM, a nonprofit, has run it since 2019; IB Tower Sdn Bhd ran it from 2015. Ilham Tower is owned via Daim family firms.
watch: Public art gallery in Kuala Lumpur committed to Southeast Asian contemporary art.
records_note: Yayasan ILHAM, the non-profit that runs it, posts no reports, accounts, funders or board; its About pages name staff only.

name: Ilmin Museum of Art
funding: Run by the Ilmin Cultural Foundation, a non-profit founded in 1994 in memory of Dong-A Ilbo president Kim Sang-man; the newspaper entrusted works to the collection.
watch: The draft's newspaper-family funds claim has no source.
records_note: Its site and foundation page carry history, awards and collection notes only: no annual reports, accounts, sponsors or board.

name: Image Factory Art Foundation (Imagination Factory)
funding: Tiny artist-run non-profit since 1995; former PM Said Musa has given the North Front Street space free for 30 years. No other funders are published.
watch: Renamed Imagination Factory in 2025. Its website is a hosting placeholder. Founder Yasser Musa is Said Musa's son.
records_note: Its website is a coming-soon placeholder, so no reports, accounts, funders or board are published.

name: Inema Arts Center
funding: Artist-run centre founded in 2012 by painter brothers Innocent Nkurunziza and Emmanuel Nkuranga.
watch: Ten resident-artist slots at KG 563 St, Kacyiru. A funder list is not published.
records_note: Inema's site names its two founders but no funders, reports, accounts or board; a Support Inema page exists but was not readable.
